charge_partition_direct_exact.charge_channel_rule: unordered pair of ORIGINAL scalar component charges; includes interference
charge_partition_direct_exact.reconstruction_relative_error_denominato: max(coherent norm, 1e-12 * sum individual term norms) to cover exact-zero cancellation
charge_partition_direct_exact.suppression_definition: Frobenius norm below 0.01 times partition maximum; never discarded
charge_partition_direct_exact.warning: Degenerate Takagi eigenvectors, individual terms and MSbar channel pieces depend on basis/scheme; only the full sum is invariant.

source_charge_and_group.warning: Source charge labels are scalar-component basis labels. The exact charge partition includes all vertex interference and is not a product of CG weights times one common loop function.

scope: restricted, direct UV p=0, frozen mu0, no EFT
